title: UP Police Recruitment Calendar 2025-26
organization: Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board
vacancyDetails: Tentative schedule of UP Police SI, Constable, ASI and other cadre recruitments
howToApply:
1. Visit https://uppbpb.gov.in
2. Check Notices / Calendar / Latest Advertisements
3. Download recruitment calendar if published
4. Track SI, Constable, ASI timelines
5. Complete OTR in advance
shortDescription: UP Police Recruitment Calendar 2025-26 – plan SI, Constable and other UPPRPB exams. Updates on uppbpb.gov.in.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board (UPPRPB) publishes recruitment notices and schedules for SI, Constable, ASI and other posts.

Candidates should follow the official calendar / advertisements on uppbpb.gov.in, complete OTR early, and prepare according to post-wise exam patterns.
